g.text: Fixed-state forecast diagnostic: current action, then the same B

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: 79 active, predetermined states: 6 outer + 70 inner + 3 full-fit states. Two pending and nine no-admission slots stay skipped.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: At all six outer states, both predicted and realized action differences in the breach event are zero; eta drops out locally.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: One realized suffix is not a true conditional probability. Sign disagreements alone do not establish forecast miscalibration.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: B is annual restoration until that branch's own breach, then pending hold; it is not the learned adaptive-policy continuation.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: The minimum-ID / fixed-year states are nonrandom and repeated; no population accuracy, confidence interval or new policy is inferred.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32
